remarks: Welcome home to this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath mobile home located in a quiet, established, and beautifully maintained mobile home park. This inviting home offers a comfortable and functional floor plan with a cozy living area, a bright kitchen. Recent upgrades include newer flooring and paint throughout, newer siding, and 2 split systems. Large front porch/patio area. This unit is uniquely positioned with a wide frontage for a more open feel and not sandwiched in between units. Enjoy the relaxed lifestyle and sense of community this well-kept park has to offer.
